brief:
The sell-off today is concentrated hardest in the names you're tracking: your AI compute and memory & storage themes fell 11.8% and 17.6% respectively, while the broader market dropped 4.4%. The Nasdaq fell 6.4%, but your semiconductor-heavy themes bore the brunt. Memory & storage took the worst of it, with SNDK down 21.7%, MU down 17%, WDC down 17.1%, and STX down 14.4% -- all moving together against their SMH benchmark's -10.8%. The AI compute theme moved as a bloc too: AMD fell 16.8%, TSM 10.2%, NVDA 9.7%, and AVGO 10.3%, clustered around a 10% drop.

Within mega-cap tech, TSLA diverged, falling 10.1% while its peers held closer to the index, dropping between 1.7% and 4.1%. In AI power & infrastructure, VRT stood out with a 13.7% drop alongside a headline about AI selling spreading to industrials, while its peers fell between 6.7% and 8%. CEG held up, down only 2.4% against a peer median of -7.7%, and reports in four days.

Off your watchlist, APP surged 31% to lead market-wide gainers, while FSLY dropped 26.9% on the losers' list. 

VST reports in one day, CEG in four days, and NVDA in twelve days. The next cluster falls in late January, with six names reporting between January 26 and 28.
